detail:
fnn-tls-initialize (tls.lisp:372 with-mutex *fnn-tls-initialize-lock* = XTLSINIT) -> fnn-tls-load-libraries (tls.lisp:345 via 381) -> fnn-tls-select-pair (tls.lisp:143-144 probe-file per candidate pair). fnn-tls-owner-reload (tls-reload.lisp:148 with-mutex *fnn-tls-reload-mutex* = XTLSRELOAD) -> fnn-tls-server-candidate (tls.lisp:533, calls fnn-tls-initialize at 533+) -> the same select-pair.
Keys: R2|fnn-tls-select-pair|XTLSINIT:probe-file, R2|fnn-tls-select-pair|XTLSRELOAD:probe-file (2 sites each). Neither lock is io_ok in tools/lock_discipline_contracts.json (lines 150-158) and both exist to serialize TLS init / reload, which already does dlopen and certificate loading under them.
Hazard: a stat of the OpenSSL library paths at init and reload; contention is only TLS init/reload itself, never O or E.
fix: Decide that XTLSINIT and XTLSRELOAD are io_ok (they serialize one-time I/O-bearing init and reload), with that justification in contracts; or hoist the candidate probe out of the locks.
notes: 10-06 20:23 Fixed: probe hoisted (fnn-tls-library-selection) before the init lock; reload initializes before its mutex; both R2 select-pair keys gone, none added; host_check read/load rc0; raw test red-before/green-after. Pending convergence natives: tests/native_tls_transport.lisp, test_native_starttls, test_native_implicit_tls, test_native_tls_handshake_budget (image/openssl).
scenario: First TLS use, or a TLS reload.
